Bring a neat festive finish to your Christmas display with this 86cm Christmas tree skirt set, designed to sit around the base of the tree and help create a more complete seasonal look. The mixed themed front designs add visual interest while keeping the overall style simple, practical and easy to coordinate with other decorations. This set includes four festive motifs inspired by classic Christmas imagery: snowman, reindeer, robin and pudding. The assorted designs give you a cheerful decorative choice for adding character beneath your tree, whether you are styling a family living room, hallway or another indoor festive space. The double layer construction is intended to give the skirt extra body, while the dense material helps it hold its shape as part of your seasonal setup. Its thick construction is designed for an attractive look and comfortable handling when arranging or removing it as part of your annual decorating routine. Whether used as part of a coordinated festive theme or simply to add a finishing touch under the tree, this set offers an easy way to introduce warmth, detail and seasonal character into the home. Ideal for anyone looking for a practical decorative base cover with classic Christmas appeal, this tree skirt combines texture, themed detailing and simple fitting in one useful seasonal accessory.
